title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
summary: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.

title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
summary: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

title: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
summary: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

title: US 401(k) proposal leaves door open to altcoins, but hurdles remain
summary: While the proposal doesn’t exclude altcoins and smaller cryptocurrencies, experts say they could face challenges getting into retirement plans.

title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
summary: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.

title: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
summary: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.

title: Bitcoin price dips under $75K as crypto markets miss tech-stock rebound
summary: BTC price action stayed weak after US nonfarm payrolls data significantly beat forecasts, increasing bets of a December interest-rate hike.

title: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
summary: The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.

title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
summary: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.
